SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS match_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.season) AS season_count,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(m.season) AS missing_seasons,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_api_id) AS missing_or_repeated_match_ids,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal IS NULL OR m.away_team_goal IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_scores,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ht.team_api_id IS NULL OR at.team_api_id IS NULL
                OR l.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS missing_dimension_matches,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN l.country_id <> m.country_id THEN 1 END) AS league_country_mismatches,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_api_id) FROM main.Team AS t) AS missing_or_repeated_team_ids
FROM main."Match" AS m
LEFT JOIN main.Team AS ht ON ht.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
LEFT JOIN main.Team AS at ON at.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
LEFT JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
LEFT JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = m.country_id

arguments.sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id,
           m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           CASE
               WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS points
    FROM main."Match" AS m

    UNION ALL

    SELECT m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id,
           m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
           CASE
               WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
               WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
               ELSE 0
           END AS points
    FROM main."Match" AS m
),
team_season_points AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id,
           SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id, total_points,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS season_rank
    FROM team_season_points
)
SELECT r.season,
       t.team_long_name AS team_name,
       l.name AS league,
       c.name AS country,
       r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.season_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, t.team_long_name, l.name, c.name
LIMIT -1
